dictionaryNotice: Bundled dictionaries/ENABLE-NOTICE.txt; public-domain ENABLE by Alan Beale with M. Cooper and contributors
normalization: Use ASCII lowercase source lines, uppercase Locale.ROOT, deduplicate, sort; length 4..32; index only words with <=7 distinct letters (other words impossible in seven-letter play)
acceptance: Every matching indexed ENABLE word including inflections, uncommon/archaic and potentially sensitive words. No unstated proper-name or frequency filter. No guesses at unsupported frequency.
familiarity: Original CLEAN Words AI editorial shortlists; 0 human-reviewed and no empirical frequency claims. Original longer/four/six-letter draft plus original Wordish shortlist copied during preprocessing. Common inflections accepted; obvious proper-name-only/sensitive/doubtful shortlist candidates excluded explicitly.
goal: Frozen bee-wordcount-v2: goalWords holds matching familiar words including at least one pangram, word target ceil(70% of their count); every accepted word receives equal one-word completion credit
defaultQuality: >=12 familiar options; 20..400 accepted options; >=3 familiar lengths; >=1 familiar four-letter word and familiar pangram. Provisional engineering filters, no Easy/Hard or 3.5/5 claim.
